# EM 385-1-1 24 Hour Training

> 24-hour online safety training developed in line with the 2024 USACE EM 385-1-1 Safety and Health Requirements Manual, for Collateral Duty Safety Officers (CDSOs), supervisors, managers and team leads on USACE and federal construction projects. Available in English and Spanish. Offered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training (https://hazwoper-osha.com).

## Key facts
- Duration: 24 hours; 17 modules, 63 lessons, final exam
- Credits: 2.4 CEU
- Price: $239.99 per person; bulk pricing available
- Delivery: 100% online, 24/7; SCORM, virtual instructor-led and in-person formats also available
- Languages: English, Spanish
- Prerequisites: none
- Certificate: certificate of completion from HAZWOPER OSHA Training; valid 3 years
- Fulfills the 24-hour CDSO refresher required every three years
- Not government-approved: federal agencies do not approve or endorse any EM 385-1-1 training course

## Modules (with EM 385-1-1 chapters)
1. Introduction to EM 385-1-1 and Safety Culture
2. Safety and Health Program Management (Ch. 1-2)
3. Sanitation, Medical and First Aid (Ch. 3)
4. Temporary Facilities and Site Conditions (Ch. 4)
5. Personal Protective and Lifesaving Equipment (Ch. 5)
6. Hazardous Materials (Ch. 6, 36)
7. Fire Prevention and Protection (Ch. 9)
8. Welding, Cutting and Brazing (Ch. 10)
9. Electrical Safety and Hazardous Energy Control (Ch. 11-12)
10. Tools and Equipment (Ch. 13)
11. Material Handling, Storage and Disposal (Ch. 14)
12. Demolition, Renovation and Specialized Construction (Ch. 17, 27, 28)
13. Vehicles, Machinery and Mechanized Equipment (Ch. 18)
14. Fall Protection (Ch. 21-24)
15. Confined Spaces (Ch. 34)
16. Excavation, Trenching and Underground Construction (Ch. 25-26)
17. Emergency Operations and Preparedness (Ch. 37)
